In this study, we compare metagenomic shotgun sequencing
(TruSeq DNA sequencin g) of wastewater samples with a state-of-the-art PCR-based
method (Resistomap HT-qPCR) on four wastewater samples that were taken from hospital,
industrial, urban and rural areas. ARGs that confer resistance to 11 antibiotic classes have
been identified in these wastewater samples using both methods, with the most abundant
observed classes of ARGs conferring resistance to aminoglycoside, multidrug-r esistance
(MDR), macrolide-lincosa mide-streptogramin B (MLSB), tetracycline and beta-lactams. In
comparing the methods, we observed a strong correlation of relative abundance of ARGs
obtained by the two tested methods for the majority of antibiotic classes. Finally, we investi-
gated the source of discrepancies in the results obtained by the two methods. This analysis
revealed that false negatives were more likely to occur in qPCR due to mutated primer target
sites, whereas ARGs with incomplete or low coverage were not detected by the sequencing
method due to the parameters set in the bioinformatics pipeline.

Disease-model and patient-derived terminology can compete with cognitive-model terms. Cas13d molecular effects in cells and BAC mice are distinct from ANN risk prediction or MRI classification accuracy.

Neuronal function and neurodegeneration are broad shared terms. Alzheimer Association funding in acknowledgments is incidental; isogenic-neuron editing and network bursting do not validate cognitive AI or MRI staging.

Neurodegeneration and human frontal-cortex observations overlap broadly. The Alzheimer Research Center is tissue-bank provenance, not an Alzheimer ANN/CNN validation cohort. PKR/eIF2α phosphorylation is not model classification performance.

Neither supplies the other study’s diagnostic history, datasets, accuracy estimates or external validation.

case_checks.rationale: No ALS/FTD article reports the named MR study’s taxa counts or internal significance discrepancy.
The named Yuan study remains MR without administered probiotics. C9orf72 interventions and any clinical-trial references concern different diseases, studies and endpoints.
RNA/DNA assays in ALS/FTD do not provide the four-site wastewater sampling design or method-specific ARG false negatives.
No ALS/FTD source supplies Garner’s 12-plant environmental abundance result.
LeBlanc’s Alzheimer-like SPECT finding is substantive adjacent competition, not evidence of either Ciftci ANN or CNN performance.

A tissue bank, clinical SPECT case and laboratory cell models are not independent ADNI/OASIS-3 validation of Ciftci’s Alzheimer models. The source’s explicit external-validation limitation remains the correction evidence.
Patient-derived neurons, BAC mice and a clinical FTD-ALS case do not supply the cited n=5 PTB probiotic alpha/beta diversity result.
ALS/FTD therapeutic discussions and cited trials do not establish AI-assisted TB precision-care superiority. The TB review still calls for comparative randomized trials.

The ALS/FTD clinical case ends in aspiration pneumonia; it supplies neither antibiotic-resistant infection ascertainment nor a link to sampled wastewater plants. The mechanistic papers study cells, tissue and animal models, not that linked patient cohort. The frozen question explicitly concerns five outliers; this supplementary nine-article review does not extend its benchmark search scope or certify full integrated-corpus absence.
Clinical cognitive decline and family history in LeBlanc do not supply Ciftci’s five-run feature-importance ranking or comorbidity interpretation.

decision: No material query/evidence/membership defect identified. Preserve both query releases, original negative-evidence scope and historical retrieval fingerprints. Extend advisory relationship/dependency records only.

handoff.integrated_absence_review: Recheck all frozen absent-fact and false-premise cases across actual cardio/diabetes/oncology/outlier/ALS-FTD membership; this audit covers nine sources, not all 55 selected articles.
handoff.selection_rationale: Cognitive/imaging bridge: x005/x006/x010 and a007/a008/a009; genetics/intervention and evidence-scope bridge: x001/x002/x007/x008 and a001/a002/a004/a005; x009 is the linked-infection absence check. Keep original 18-topic regression sample for comparability, but add justified ALS/FTD-sensitive controls after combined alternative review. x003/x004 have distant assay overlap only; a003/a006/a010 need no audit-driven gold revision. Complete final benchmark claims still require complete declared coverage.
handoff.run_requirements: Before runs, freeze accepted alternatives and negative scope, ingest isolated declared nested corpora with SEED_ON_EMPTY=false, preserve requested/executed IDs and fingerprints. Report decoy exposure and evidence metrics separately; no generation/refusal accuracy inferred. Paid calls require explicit run approval.
